hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'gh pr (merge|create)'; then echo 'Reminder: Before PR, ensure /quality → /simplify → /self-review have been run.' >&2; fi; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'git tag v'; then echo 'Reminder: Ensure /quality has passed before tagging a release.' >&2; fi; exit 0
curl -sf http://localhost:8080/health >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo 'Kagura Memory Cloud is connected.  Run /kagura-memory:session-start to restore previous session context.' || true

file_path=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); [ -z "$file_path" ] && exit 0; case "$file_path" in *.py) uv run ruff format --quiet "$file_path" 2>/dev/null;; esac; case "$file_path" in */memory/*.md) echo 'Memory updated. Consider /kagura-memory:session-summary to sync with Kagura Memory.' >&2;; esac; exit 0
